messages:
Maya: Deployed q6b-int4 to staging for a quick smoke. Throughput improved but noticing quality drift on longform summarization prompts (>512 tokens). Thinking we should do a targeted golden relabel + dedupe sweep before promoting. :thinking:
Sam: Can you paste a failing example and the metric diffs so we can see signal vs noise?
Maya: Example (redacted):
```input
Article: ... <long article> ...
Expected: Focused TL;DR listing outcomes
q5-baseline: Good concise summary, mentions 3 outcomes
q6b-int4: Adds a non-existent statistic, misses outcome #2
```
Devin: I ran a batch eval earlier. Deltas vs q5: ROUGE-L -2.3, ROUGE-1 -1.1, hallucination increase +0.08. Failures concentrate on inputs with KV-cache > 40k tokens and when attention tiling kicks in. Looks like an interaction between the new int4 kernel tiling and cache management.
Sam: No tokenizer changes in this bring-up, right? That would be a quick explanation.
Maya: No tokenizer diff. We switched attention tiling path for int4 to reduce memory, which could alter numeric stability. I'm reproing locally, will attach logs.
Maya: Repro command: ```bash
./bench_eval.sh --model q6b-int4 --prompts promptset_longform --out /tmp/q6b_diffs.json\```
Rachel: Labeling ops can prioritize a 200-sample relabel of the golden seed. If you surface sample ids and a priority tag I’ll spin it up.
label-bot: Created LabelFlow task LR-482 for "q6b-int4 longform relabel" with 200 items, priority: high, ETA 48h. :robot_face:
Devin: I'd also like to run a small ablation: int4 w/ alternate kernel flag, int8 baseline, and int4 with fallback attention path. If regression disappears under alternate kernel, we'll know it's kernel-specific.
Sam: Proposed triage plan: 1) kick off golden relabel 200 (Rachel) 2) run quant/kernel ablation (Devin) 3) if relabeled gold still regresses, route >512-token requests to q5 canary while we triage and prepare a runtime rollback.
Rachel: Stand up relabel now. Setting QA threshold to 95% pass for that batch. Will ping labelers and post LR link. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy q6b-int4 -> staging completed at 1768520005.
Maya: I'll collect relabel diffs and ablation outputs and post results. If labels confirm drift tied to int4 kernel, we'll open a kernel rollback ticket with eng-runtime.
Sam: Sounds good. Please @channel when you have the relabel summary or if ablation isolates the kernel. :raised_hands:
